humanSurface.rule: The human view renders shared state; it never owns a hidden second truth.

boundaries: A raw session is not automatically a lesson.
A fluent challenger is not automatically better.
Forge apply changes only the Forge's isolated active pointer.
A Mirror Core export remains DRAFT and cannot apply itself.
HTTP writes require a local bearer token.
Only one metered learning operation may run at a time.
Memory pressure or a red Body Pulse holds learning before learner state changes.
Automatic learning requires a live lease for the Mirror Learning Forge module.
Resource consumption is body cost, never evidence that learning improved.
Every non-health HTTP state route requires the local bearer token.
Coding is parsed and graded statically; arbitrary submissions are not executed.
Studio plans do not receive pixel or tool authority and require later visual receipts.
Grades never grant canon, identity, runtime, permission, network, filesystem, tool, apply, or promotion authority.
Adaptive delivery may not silently change facts, evidence status, uncertainty, consent, lineage, risk, identity, or permissions.
No evaluated Workshop action is executed by this module.
